caption-buttons.description: On Windows the window has no frame (W8), so the page draws its minimize, maximize and close buttons. Minimize and close are Windows' own. Close puts the window away, as on the Mac. The middle button zooms, through the window's own zoom command. macOS draws its own buttons, so it gets none of this.

window.description: The page draws the title bar, so it moves the window, and a double click on the bar zooms it, as a title bar does. Nothing else: events reach the page by drain_lines, and a working listen would show every line twice.
